name: Wizz Air

evidence.claim: One of the strictest airlines in Europe. Bags are checked at the gate as a matter of routine, not just when they look oversized.

allowances.note: Base fare includes an underseat item, not an overhead bag; paid or membership exceptions require the appropriate entitlement. Published box excludes handles/wheels; wheels may add at most 5 cm. No automatic dimension adjustment applied.

audit_note: Read live baggage allowance page. Free 40x30x20 10 kg; Priority adds 55x40x23 10 kg. Handles/wheels excluded; wheels may add at most 5 cm. That protrusion rule is not enforced by current engine. Shared-weight groups, linear constraints, aircraft and entitlement exceptions require further engine/publication review.
